297752.t: Dr. Prakash Baba Amte: The Real Hero
297752.ov: Dr Prakash Baba Amte : The Real Hero is a Marathi film on biopic of Dr. Prakash Amte featuring actors like Nana Patekar and Sonali Kulkarni.

1098264.ov: The story revolves around Dr. Aarti Deshmukh, a mother of a daughter, is tasked with investigating the medical systems involved in female foeticide. In front of the conscientious Aarti who does her job well, Dr. Purushottam stands as a challenge.

1108504.ov: Upstream, the Kukadi River has dried up. Downstream, it has been dammed and its waters exploited. Filmmaker Aisha Jain explores the activities that take place along this river that runs through rural India, as well as the more intimate relationships people have with its waters.

1156120.ov: Three friends Shree, Aditya and Manav are blind, deaf and dumb respectively. To get rid of their financial problems they decide to start a detective agency. Will they succeed?

1159704.ov: An ambitious girl wishes to lead a simple life and who desires to lead a simple life, and who desires to fulfill her dreams. However, as in life nothing goes as decided and something unacceptable happens.

1213464.ov: Rajaaka (Akkasaheb) and Hindurao Inamadar are married for 12 years but are still childless, following which Akka wants Inamdar to marry another lady but he denies the prospect all the time. Inamdar has a lot of respect in his village and has helped many people.

1478040.ov: This is the story of two friends standing at a crossroads, where growing up means making difficult choices and prioritizing what matters most. Savi is leaving her life in Bombay for a new job in Alibaug, while her roommate, Anu, grapples with feelings that go beyond friendship.
